title: NAILS activate --json
description: Machine-readable activate envelope (contract version 2): exactly one document on stdout. It reports the outcome: a success is printed only once the soft-reboot is enqueued, so a failure to enqueue it is the one document (the error `soft_reboot`, no data, ok false, exit 1) and never follows a success. The soft-reboot then stops every program of the decoy, the reader included, so a reader stopped first may not read the success. The version-1 progress line stream is gone; a window watches progress on its own channel. A success or a success with warnings carries data and is ok; a cancel is the shared cancel shape (an error with the code `cancelled`, no data); a failed entry keeps its data with ok false. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9.
